conclusion: The center cancellation charge is STRUCTURALLY ESSENTIAL: removing it enlarges the field-null from the cycle space to the full internal-face space (null = n_internal_faces = cycles + (n_cells-1)); the RAW solve has ~63% net charge and >100% moment error. The (n_cells-1) extra null modes are monopole-type: RAW + div(B)=0 + loop deflation removes them, restores bounded conditioning AND recovers ~1% accuracy vs MMM. So div(B)=0-by-Lagrange CAN replace the center charge, but must deflate BOTH loops and monopoles -- what the single center charge does implicitly for free.
